2609.08698.title: Record Grouping Controls Evidence Weight in Language Models
2609.08698.paper_summary: Retrieved records are presentation units; a supplied partition determines which records enter a language model as one evidential contribution. We characterize the invariant group-content state that removes within-group copies while retaining complementary canonical content, show that equal group counts can encode different evidence states, and derive a sharp content-aware partition-error bound. Given a supplied partition, our pre-generation representation deduplicates and aggregates content within groups and bounds each group's contribution. Across 104,402 trials and 6 public checkpoints, a central natural-text intervention finds that content-fixed false splits add 10.27-32.66 percentage points and false merges remove 9.13-31.79 points; a matched six-slot control retains the positive direction in all 16 cells. In a new 48-item controlled campaign panel, changing the supplied partition produces measurable, checkpoint-dependent decision shifts across all four models, and the balanced mirror design exposes substantial order interactions. Together, the theory and experiments establish the supplied partition as a controllable pre-generation representation variable and characterize its checkpoint-dependent behavioral effects.
2609.08698.paper_summary_zh: 檢索的記錄是呈現單元；提供的分區決定哪些記錄作為一個證據貢獻進入語言模型。我們描述了去除組內副本的恆定群組內容狀態，同時保留互補的典範內容，顯示相等的群組計數可以編碼不同的證據狀態，並推導出一個明確的內容感知分區錯誤界限。給定一個提供的分區，我們的預生成表示在群組內去重並聚合內容，並界定每個群組的貢獻。在104,402次試驗和6個公共檢查點中，一個中央自然文本干預發現，內容固定的錯誤拆分增加了10.27-32.66個百分點，而錯誤合併則減少了9.13-31.79個百分點；一個匹配的六槽控制在所有16個單元中保持正向方向。在一個新的48項控制活動面板中，改變提供的分區在所有四個模型中產生可測量的、依賴檢查點的決策變化，而平衡鏡像設計揭示了實質的順序互動。理論和實驗共同確立了提供的分區作為一個可控的預生成表示變數，並描述其依賴檢查點的行為效應。
